title: Bihar Police Seize $13,000 Worth of Cannabis from Vehicle in Gonda
summary: On [date], Bihar police intercepted a vehicle carrying $13,000 worth of cannabis from Bihar to Jharkhand. Two alleged smugglers were arrested during the operation. The police claimed that they had been tracking the vehicle for several days and had set up a checkpoint to monitor suspicious activity. The two men were identified as [names] from Bihar and were suspected of transporting the illicit substance. The police said they would investigate further to determine the origin of the cannabis.
summary_points: Bihar police intercepted a vehicle carrying $13,000 worth of cannabis on [date].
The vehicle was traveling from Bihar to Jharkhand.
Two alleged smugglers were arrested during the operation.
The police claimed they had been tracking the vehicle for several days.
title_hi: बिहार पुलिस ने गोड्डा से 13 हजार रुपये की गांजा जब्त की, दो तस्कर गिरफ्तार
summary_hi: गोड्डा में बिहार से झारखंड ले जाने वाले दो तस्करों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया, जिसमें $13,000 की गांजा जब्त हुई। पुलिस ने बताया कि उन्होंने कई दिनों से उस वाहन पर नजर रखी थी।
summary_points_hi: गोड्डा में बिहार से झारखंड ले जाने वाले दो तस्करों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया।
वाहन में $13,000 की गांजा जब्त हुई थी।
दो तस्करों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया, जिनमें से दोनों बिहार के निवासी थे।

framing_hi.center: पुलिस ने गोड्डा से बिहार से झारखंड ले जाने वाले दो तस्करों को गिरफ्तार कर लिया, इस मामले में $13,000 की गांजा जब्त हुई।
